# Acel Cortex

> Acel Cortex is AI for property management back offices. It takes the first pass on accounts payable and owner billing, and a person on the property manager's team approves everything before it posts. Built by property managers who run their own property management companies on it.

## What it does today
- Collects vendor invoices from the inbox and reads them
- Matches each invoice to its work order and flags duplicates
- Works out the charge to the owner and the property manager's profit on each invoice
- Posts the approved batch to the property management software
- Works on top of Buildium, AppFolio and Rentvine, with no migration
- Optional chat assistant on Telegram for approvals and quick tasks

## Built in-house, rolling out next
- Maintenance request triage and main inbox management
- Rental analysis, rental application assessment and owner leasing updates
- Notices: rent increase, late rent, lease renewal, notice of entry

## Key facts
- Nothing posts without human approval
- Setup takes about two weeks
- Pricing is per unit; quotes are given on a 30-minute call
- Serves property management companies in the US and Canada, roughly 50 to 2,000 units
